title: AI Specialist Diagnosis and Treatment Resources - Ophthalmology Model
summary: In the makers' randomized trial, students taught with a digital patient built on the ChatZOC retrieval framework scored 10.5 points higher in history taking; clinical benefits remain intended.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Zhongshan Ophthalmic Center built ChatZOC, a specialist ophthalmology model for knowledge questions, diagnostic assistance, and teaching. From 14 November to 7 December 2023, the center's team ran a randomized trial of a digital-patient teaching system built on the ChatZOC retrieval framework with 84 medical students. In its submission to the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, the center reports pilots across regions of China. The center says that the approach can improve access and support clinicians. The submission supplies no measured clinical improvement or individual health outcome. The team reports in npj Digital Medicine (4 August 2025) that students trained with the digital-patient system scored 10.5 points higher in history taking than students trained with real patients. No study by an outside group and no patient outcome from the clinical pilots had appeared by October 2026.
purpose: Support ophthalmic diagnosis, education, and remote access to expertise.
model_version: ChatZOC language model fine-tuned by the Zhongshan Ophthalmic Center on a Qwen 2.5 open-source base (2025); the 2024 study version used Baichuan-13B
developer: Zhongshan Ophthalmic Center, Sun Yat-sen University
